feature: Lazy load Plotly.js to reduce initial bundle size by ~3MB
description: The analytics view imports plotly.js-dist-min (~3MB minified) at the top level via `import Plotly from 'plotly.js-dist-min'`. This massive library is loaded for all users even if they never use the analytics/pivot table feature. Plotly should be dynamically imported only when the analytics view is accessed.
